name: m5-scaling-heap-rejuv
description: `chunked-weak-rejuv` under `m5-scaling-heap`'s settings (1.5 GB of heap per concurrent compile, 4 MB regions, Graal 25.4.4, M5 Pro), to compare with that campaign's `chained-weak` and `chunked-weak` cells. At this heap share chunks are promoted and dirty cards, and `chunked-weak`'s lead stayed at 5–17% for every N. Hypothesis: copying recently written element chunks after each GC keeps them young and restores the gap. Run separately, so drift between the campaigns is not controlled.
